title: Payroll tax filing records

title: Cyber insurance policy summary

title: BIA interviews: service lines, Associate Service Center, Government Solutions, HR, finance, analytics and ACQ-1 owners

source_system: Vendor contracts; DR test records; vendor assurance reviews

source_system: Cloud provider B (observation)

title: Risk analysis workshops
source_system: Workshops (SOC; Payroll and Associate Services; Treasury; Talent Acquisition Technology; Employment Compliance; Integration Management Office; Third-Party Risk; Data and Analytics; Government Solutions; Healthcare Staffing; Finance)

title: Gap analysis interviews with control owners
source_system: Interviews (CISO; Chief Compliance Officer; Chief Privacy Officer; Vice President, Employment Compliance; Director of Employment Eligibility Compliance; Director of Security Operations; Director of Identity and Access Management; Director of Third-Party Risk Management; General Counsel; Vice President, Government Solutions)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each requirement is carried out today and where the records are kept

source_system: Identity governance; learning system; physical access system; data platform
what_it_shows: 2026 Q2 access certification: 60 of about 31,000 tier-1 application entitlements traced to approvals, 2 without an approval record; 2026 Q2 badge review: 25 of about 520 payroll center badge holders matched, no exceptions; learning system report (2026-07): 97% of 12,000 internal employees complete, 3% overdue, phishing click rate 3.1%; 2026 Q2 vishing simulation results for the service desk; inactivity job report (2026-07); role template review (2026-06); data platform access review (2026-06) lists 41 named analytics users with clear-text column access

title: Gap analysis samples and records: operations, change and recovery
source_system: Backup reports; patch reports; posture management; WMP SDLC records; SOC cases; branch network configurations; parallel payroll records
what_it_shows: 6 of 6 monthly payroll database restore tests (2026 H1) recorded; 60 of about 900 tier-1 servers sampled for patching, 1 on an unsupported operating system (the time clock server); posture report for about 180 cloud accounts with no critical deviation open past its timeframe; 25 WMP releases (2026 H1) with threat modeling, code review and testing records; 60 of about 8,400 SOC cases (2026 H1) triaged and handled under runbooks, no exceptions; configuration check of all 380 branches, 46 with lobby kiosks on the staff network; 2026 Q2 parallel payroll results for releases and tax table updates

title: Gap analysis samples and records: Form I-9 and E-Verify
source_system: Onboarding and Form I-9 platform (SYS-02); E-Verify reports; HR records
what_it_shows: 2026 Q2 internal I-9 audit; 60 of about 118,000 Forms I-9 (2026 H1), 2 with Section 2 completed late; 40 of about 9,600 alternative-procedure forms with the live video record and box checked, no exceptions; 40 forms of associates terminated in 2023 present with retention dates; 60 of about 1,300 SYS-02 users with I-9 image access matched the 2026 Q2 certification, no exceptions; 25 of about 240 new E-Verify users completed the tutorial first, no exceptions; 60 of about 118,000 E-Verify cases, 3 created late; 25 of about 620 associates assigned to federal contracts verified, no exceptions; 25 of about 15,000 Florida hires verified, no exceptions; E-Verify user list (2026-06) and the 2026 Q2 quarterly review: 37 accounts of departed users still active; login review and user interviews found no shared accounts

title: Mock Form I-9 inspection
source_system: SYS-02 and the DC-2 scanned archive (test)
what_it_shows: 35 forms requested in a mock inspection; electronic forms and their audit trails were produced from SYS-02 within minutes; 2 forms from the 2009-2012 scanned archive were produced after the 3-business-day mark

title: Gap analysis samples: FCRA, vendors, contracts and NYC postings
source_system: Screening provider records; vendor register and contracts; SYS-01 postings
what_it_shows: 60 of about 95,000 screening orders (2026 H1) had electronic authorization before release, no exceptions; 60 of about 7,800 adverse actions had both notices with the 5-business-day wait, no exceptions; 40 of 220 contracts with vendors holding personal information reviewed, 4 without a 72-hour notice term; 25 of 38 vendors with personal information onboarded in 2026 H1 had due diligence before contract, no exceptions; 40 of about 2,300 NYC postings (2026 H1), 3 without the Local Law 144 notice

title: Government Solutions FAR 52.204-21 review
source_system: SYS-01 and SYS-03 configuration; Government Solutions contract files; interview with the Vice President, Government Solutions
what_it_shows: Each of the 15 FAR 52.204-21(b)(1) requirements traced to SYS-01 and SYS-03 controls; Government Solutions roles limited to their contracts; agency job postings reviewed before posting; all 34 federal contracts checked: 4 still receive agency timesheets as email attachments, some from agency supervisors' personal accounts; no CUI found in the contracts

title: Record-age and retention review, and data inventory update
source_system: SYS-01, SYS-02 and data platform record-age queries; data inventory
what_it_shows: Full population query: about 1.9 million applications and 410,000 consumer reports are past the retention schedule; Forms I-9 past their retention date are still held in SYS-02; electronic consumer reports have never been purged; data platform extracts have no retention or purge rule; the data inventory was updated in 2026-07 to list the data platform's copies of SSNs and bank account numbers

title: Governance records collected during fieldwork
source_system: GRC platform; board portal; Internal Audit planning files
what_it_shows: Chief Compliance Officer's legal and contractual register (2026-06) with no entries yet for state AI employment laws or the ACQ-1 contracts; risk and technology committee minutes (2026-06) recording the annual supply chain report; security strategy review (2026-07) after the acquisitions; policy review log (2026-08); draft 2027 Internal Audit plan, whose scope is not mapped to the CPPA cybersecurity audit requirements

title: Counsel memo on Colorado and California automated decision duties
source_system: General Counsel's office
what_it_shows: Counsel's analysis, started 2026-07, of Colorado SB26-189 deployer duties and California CPPA ADMT duties for AI-001 decisions about applicants from 2027-01-01 (notice, post-adverse-outcome disclosure, correction and human review, 3-year records, pre-use notice, opt-out or exception basis and access); no design for these duties is recorded yet; notes Connecticut Public Act 26-15 (effective 2026-10-01) from the Attorney General's release, with the act text still to be read

title: 2026-2027 security budget approval
source_system: Finance planning records
what_it_shows: About $4.9 million of security treatment funded for 2026 Q4 to 2027 Q2, mapped to the POA&M items

title: AI portfolio review: registrations and changes since intake
source_system: AI governance council site; procurement and change records
what_it_shows: AI-007 remote interview identity verification pilot (Professional Staffing remote IT hires since 2026-07; Illinois candidates excluded; vendor demographic accuracy data requested) registered, which brings the inventory to 11 use cases, 6 with completed council review; free-text screening questions removed from the candidate chatbot (AI-004) in 2026-08; since 2026-08 procurement and the change process block AI features without an inventory ID

title: AI-001 first firm-data bias and validity analysis (2026 Q2 data)
source_system: SYS-01 ranking data; voluntary self-identification data; vendor feature-weight report
what_it_shows: Top-third placement rates by sex and by race or ethnicity per segment: Commercial Staffing impact ratios of 0.78 for women (z = 23.3) and 0.77 for Hispanic or Latino applicants (z = 9.9), both below 0.80 with significant differences; Professional (IT) ratio by sex 0.93; validity agreement of 88% (Commercial) and 93% (Professional) on 400 applicants per segment; vendor feature-weight report received 2026-08-14; self-identification response of 61% for Commercial Staffing applicants in 2026 Q2

title: Control assessment: Account management samples and analytics
source_system: Identity governance workflows; SYS-01 to SYS-04 user exports; E-Verify user list; integration service account inventory; HR termination records
what_it_shows: 60 sampled ALPP account events matched approved requests and role templates; 3 of 40 sampled ACQ-1 terminations were disabled 2 to 9 days late; 37 departed users still held E-Verify accounts; E-Verify program administrators receive no termination notice and disablement depends on a quarterly review; the about 400 client integration service accounts have no review record; shared client integration accounts are not re-keyed when people with knowledge of the key leave

title: Control assessment: Atypical account use analytics
source_system: Fraud rule set; bank-change records (about 41,000 associate and 1,900 staff changes, 2026 H1); SIEM rules
what_it_shows: Atypical staff bank changes are scored, held and reported to the fraud team; associate bank changes are not monitored for new device, new location or a change shortly before payroll; 11 of 60 flagged associate changes reviewed were confirmed fraudulent

title: Control assessment: Access enforcement test
source_system: ALPP role matrix; SYS-02 role export; 4 audit test accounts; 25 users
what_it_shows: Access of all 25 sampled users matched the role matrix; Form I-9 images and consumer reports were not reachable from recruiter roles

title: Control assessment: Separation of duties review
source_system: Payroll role matrix; SYS-03 role assignments (38 configuration administrators); Payroll Engine Application Manager interview
what_it_shows: Separation of duties is documented; all 38 payroll configuration administrators can also release a payroll

title: Control assessment: Privileged session sample
source_system: PAM elevation sessions (25 of 2,640); export rights list
what_it_shows: Each sampled session was approved, time-limited and recorded; bulk export rights are limited to 14 roles

title: Control assessment: Remote access review
source_system: Zero-trust access policies; PAM vendor gateway log; 3 remote access paths; 6 vendor support accounts
what_it_shows: Remote and vendor access ran only through the approved, recorded paths

title: Control assessment: Training records and phishing results
source_system: Learning system; phishing simulation results; 60 training records
what_it_shows: 59 of 60 sampled staff completed training (1 on approved leave); phishing click rate 3.1% over the 6 months examined

title: Control assessment: Role-based training records and mystery-shopper calls
source_system: Role-based curricula; training records (25 per group); 10 mystery-shopper calls to the Associate Service Center
what_it_shows: Role-based training for payroll approvers, I-9 reviewers and administrators was completed before access; Associate Service Center agents had no bank-change social engineering training before handling changes; 2 of 10 mystery-shopper calls changed a bank account; the 214 fraud cases of 2025 were not used to update agent or payroll role-based training

title: Control assessment: Event logging test
source_system: Logging standard; ALPP event list; 8 event types generated in test
what_it_shows: All 8 generated event types (including bank change, pay rule change, release, export and I-9 change) were logged and reached the SIEM

title: Control assessment: Audit review records, bulk export test and log source check
source_system: SIEM use case list; SOC review records (5 of 26 weeks); log source inventory (148 sources); audit test export of 5,000 synthetic associate records
what_it_shows: Findings are reported to owners through the case system; no use case reviews ATS or payroll engine exports for bulk extraction, and the audit test export of 5,000 records raised no alert (reported to the CISO 2026-08-13); 9 of 148 expected tier-1 log sources send no logs, including the ACQ-1 directory, ATS and edge VPN

title: Control assessment: Audit generation check
source_system: Audit configuration of 11 ALPP components, including the DC-2 archive file server
what_it_shows: Audit generation is turned on and selectable in the SaaS tenants and the payroll engine; the scanned I-9 archive file server in DC-2 generates no access or change records

title: Control assessment: Assessment program review
source_system: Assessment plan; Internal Audit charter; 2025 and 2026 assessments
what_it_shows: Independent assessments were planned and performed and results were reported to the audit committee

title: Control assessment: Continuous monitoring review
source_system: Monthly metric packages (3 of 6); KRI dashboard
what_it_shows: Metrics were produced and reviewed by the executive risk committee for the 3 sampled months

title: Control assessment: Baseline comparison
source_system: Image pipeline; configuration baseline v2026.2; 6 payroll engine servers
what_it_shows: All 6 servers were built from current hardened images

title: Control assessment: Payroll change and release sample
source_system: Change tickets; payroll configuration change log; approvals; 40 of about 1,150 configuration changes and 25 of 96 releases (2026 H1)
what_it_shows: Sampled releases went through the change board with security review; 5 of 40 sampled pay rule and tax table changes were approved only by the person who made them and have no documented change decision

title: Control assessment: Configuration settings inspection and time clock test
source_system: Posture reports for 6 payroll engine servers; time clock configuration inspection (25 of 140, 9 sites, with site approval)
what_it_shows: Server and cloud settings match the baseline; 9 of 25 sampled time clocks still had the vendor default administrator PIN and factory settings (reported to the CISO 2026-08-06)

title: Control assessment: Inventory trace
source_system: CMDB; floor-to-CMDB trace of 60 devices at 6 sites
what_it_shows: All 60 traced devices were in the CMDB with owners; time clocks are recorded by site only, without firmware version or administrator settings

title: Control assessment: Contingency plan review
source_system: ALPP contingency plan v3; DR test report; 4 interviews
what_it_shows: The plan covers essential functions, roles, the advance procedure and restoration priorities; it was not updated for the problems found in the 2026-05-16 DR test (manual endpoint re-pointing, replicas not pre-staged), and those lessons are not in the next test plan

title: Control assessment: DR test review
source_system: DR test plan and report of 2026-05-16; interviews
what_it_shows: The annual test ran, results were reviewed and corrective actions were opened

title: Control assessment: Backup sample and restore observation
source_system: Backup job reports (25 of 181); 1 restore observed
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled jobs completed with immutable copies, and the observed restore succeeded

title: Control assessment: DR test timeline review
source_system: DR test report
what_it_shows: The payroll engine recovered in 9.5 hours against the 8-hour RTO; reconstitution to a known state was confirmed by a parallel payroll check

title: Control assessment: Sign-in sample
source_system: SSO application list; sign-in logs; 25 sign-ins
what_it_shows: Workforce users were uniquely identified and authenticated through SSO; E-Verify users through named DHS accounts

title: Control assessment: Privileged MFA check
source_system: PAM and MFA policy; 64 privileged ALPP accounts
what_it_shows: All 64 privileged accounts use FIDO2 keys

title: Control assessment: Authenticator analytics and time clock credential test
source_system: Secrets vault report (about 400 integration keys); time clock test (25 clocks, with site approval); password policy
what_it_shows: Password policy and vaulting meet STD-02.2; 63 client integration API keys are older than 2 years against a 90-day rotation standard; shared integration credentials are not changed when people with access leave; 9 of 25 sampled time clocks still used the vendor default administrator PIN (reported to the CISO 2026-08-06)

title: Control assessment: Associate authentication review
source_system: Associate app identity settings; fraud report; about 310,000 associate accounts
what_it_shows: Associates are uniquely identified and authenticate with a password plus an SMS code; 214 fraudulent bank changes in 2025 followed that sign-in

title: Control assessment: Identity proofing sample
source_system: Onboarding records; alternative procedure videos; E-Verify results; 25 of about 118,000 new associates
what_it_shows: Each sampled associate was identity-proofed against Form I-9 documents and E-Verify before the self-service account was bound

title: Control assessment: Incident handling sample
source_system: SOC case records (25 of about 8,400); ACQ-1 incident log (all 5, 2026 H1)
what_it_shows: Sampled SOC cases were handled through preparation, analysis, containment, eradication and recovery; 3 of 5 ACQ-1 incidents were handled by ACQ-1 IT with no SOC case

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting sample and staff interviews
source_system: Incident reports (25 cases); 20 staff interviews
what_it_shows: Staff knew how to report, and sampled reports reached the SOC within 1 hour

title: Control assessment: Incident response plan and materiality playbook review
source_system: IR plan; disclosure playbook v2; interviews with the General Counsel, CFO and CISO
what_it_shows: The plan defines reportable incidents, roles and the materiality step and is distributed and protected; the plan and playbook were not updated for the new CFO and General Counsel and have no cost model for a PII breach; changes since 2025 were not communicated to the two new disclosure committee members

title: Control assessment: Media sanitization trace
source_system: Certificates of destruction; vendor contract; 25 of about 2,100 retired devices (2026 H1)
what_it_shows: Every sampled device had a certificate of destruction

title: Control assessment: Termination sample
source_system: HR termination records; disablement timestamps; 60 enterprise and 40 ACQ-1 terminations (same sample as AC-2)
what_it_shows: Enterprise terminations were disabled within 4 hours; 3 of 40 sampled ACQ-1 terminations were disabled 2 to 9 days late

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: 2026 risk register (P01); committee records; GRC interview
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment was performed with SP 800-30, reviewed, disseminated and reported to the board

title: Control assessment: Vulnerability finding sample
source_system: Scan reports; remediation tickets; 60 of about 3,800 critical and high findings
what_it_shows: Scans run weekly with current signatures and results are analyzed; 7 of 60 sampled critical and high findings on integration platform servers were past the 15-day timeframe

title: Control assessment: External service review
source_system: Vendor register; contracts; SOC report reviews for 14 external services
what_it_shows: Oversight roles are defined and most contracts carry security terms; screening provider 2's contract has no 72-hour incident notice term; the paycard program manager's SOC report has not been reviewed since 2024

title: Control assessment: Unsupported component review
source_system: Unsupported component register
what_it_shows: The time clock server in DC-1 runs an unsupported operating system; alternative support is documented through an exception

title: Control assessment: Boundary review and kiosk reachability test
source_system: Network policies; reachability test from a lobby kiosk at 2 legacy branches
what_it_shows: External and cloud boundaries are monitored and controlled; from a lobby kiosk at 2 of 2 legacy branches tested, the auditor reached internal file shares and the branch printer management page

title: Control assessment: Transmission protection test
source_system: TLS scan of user and API endpoints; SFTP configuration
what_it_shows: All ALPP interfaces use TLS 1.2 or higher, and bank and tax files use SFTP with file encryption

title: Control assessment: Encryption at rest inspection
source_system: Database and backup encryption settings; tokenization configuration
what_it_shows: Encryption at rest with customer-managed keys; SSNs and bank numbers tokenized inside the payroll engine

title: Control assessment: Patch sample
source_system: Patch reports for payroll engine servers; 25 of 214 patches (2026 H1)
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled payroll engine patches were tested and installed within the timeframe

title: Control assessment: Monitoring review and bulk export test
source_system: SIEM use cases; audit test export of 5,000 synthetic associate records; rule review
what_it_shows: Network, endpoint and identity monitoring operates 24x7; monitoring did not detect the audit test export of 5,000 associate records (reported to the CISO 2026-08-13); monitoring was not raised when associate bank-change fraud rose in 2025

title: Control assessment: Integrity monitoring review and pay file alteration test
source_system: File integrity monitoring; SFTP staging design; alteration of a copy of a paycard funding file in the test environment
what_it_shows: File integrity monitoring runs on payroll engine servers; no tool checks bank and paycard files on the staging server, and the altered test file passed; no action is defined for an altered pay file

title: Control assessment: Intake validation test
source_system: Intake validation rules; 20 test SL-2 intake files in the test environment
what_it_shows: SL-2 intake accepted 6 of 20 test files with unreasonable values (pay rate 10 times normal, 168 hours a week)

title: Control assessment: Retention query review
source_system: Retention schedule STD-04.2; record-age queries of SYS-01, SYS-02 and the data platform
what_it_shows: Information is managed under the schedule's categories; about 1.9 million applications, 410,000 consumer reports and Forms I-9 past their retention date are still kept; data platform extracts have no retention or purge rule

title: Control assessment: Supplier assessment analytics
source_system: Vendor assessment schedule; 220 vendors with personal information
what_it_shows: 31 of 220 vendors with personal information have no current assessment
